paragraphs.text: Read Geneva "Isa 13:1"
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: You of Cilicia that come here for merchandise.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Tyrus is destroyed by Nebuchadnezzar.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: By Chittim they meant all the isles and countries west of Palestine.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: All men know of this destruction.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Have hunted and enriched you.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Meaning, the corn of Egypt which was fed by the overflowing of the Nile.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, Tyrus, which was the chief part of the sea.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: I have no people left in me, and am as a barren woman, that never had children.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Because these two countries were joined in league together.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: greatly pained at the report of

paragraphs.text: Tyrus wills other merchants to go to Cilicia, and to come no more there.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Who makes her merchants like princes.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Your strength will no more serve you: therefore flee to other countries for comfort.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: For Tyre was never touched nor afflicted before.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: Because Tyrus was built by them of Zidon.
paragraphs.label: p

paragraphs.text: The Chaldeans who dwelt in tents in the wilderness were gathered by the Assyrians into cities.
paragraphs.label: q
paragraphs.anchor: Assyrian founded it for them that

paragraphs.text: The people of the Chaldeans destroyed the Assyrians: by which the prophet means that seeing the Chaldaeans were able to overcome the Assyrians who were so great a nation, much more will these two nations of Chaldea and Assyria be able to overthrow Tyrus.
paragraphs.label: r

paragraphs.text: That is, Tyrus by whom you are enriched.
paragraphs.label: s

paragraphs.text: Tyrus will lie destroyed seventy years which he calls the reign of one king, or a man's age.
paragraphs.label: t

paragraphs.text: Will use all craft and subtilty to entice men again to her.
paragraphs.label: u

paragraphs.text: She will labour by all means to recover her first credit, as a harlot when she is long forgotten, seeks by all means to entertain her lovers.
paragraphs.label: x

paragraphs.text: Though she has been chastised by the Lord, yet she will return to her old wicked practises and for gain will give herself to all men's lusts like a harlot.
paragraphs.label: y

paragraphs.text: He shows that God yet by the preaching of the gospel will call Tyre to repentance and turn her heart from evil and filthy gain, to the true worshipping of God, and liberality toward his saints.
paragraphs.label: z
